title: Staff CI dashboard reports exact-head PR checks, runner assignments and actionable lifecycle filters
steps: Run the ops CI reader, runner execution and dashboard helper test suites on the PR checkout.
Check exact-head readiness, staff admission, job/runner identity matching, lifecycle filters and agent handoff assertions.
With TEST_DATABASE_URL pointing at an isolated test database, run ops-ci-pg.test.mjs. In the real CI component stories, verify ReadUnread bulk saving beyond page one and AutoRead dwell behavior.
expect: A green old SHA or skipped-only checks cannot make a PR Ready.
Signed-out and nonstaff requests never reach GitHub.
Job runner observations join only the exact check id, run attempt and PR head SHA.
CI job waiting and active job filters are separate from GitHub merge queue; merged PRs do not appear in running stages.
Agent handoff names the PR, head commit and failed checks, and explains that merged failures do not block merge.
Unread PRs show New and semibold rows; read status belongs to each Tracy account and survives refresh, head and CI status changes.
The whole-run deadline stops the next child after the preceding real check completes, independently of subprocess speed.
Automatic merge targets only develop and never uses a stale head, incomplete checks or a pending/changes-requested review.
Branch and Updated/Created/Merged date scope read paginated GitHub history beyond 30 merged PRs before table paging.
Custom calendar days have an inclusive local start and exclusive next-day UTC upper bound; another filter scope never inherits stale rows.

Only active continuous viewport exposure for 3 seconds, or hover/focus for 2 seconds, marks a row read. Mark all covers the selected author and loaded branch/date scope across pages; unsuccessful writes keep unread badges.
fence: Deterministic units and route tests; production GitHub data is not a test fixture. Visual layout was inspected separately on the local built SPA.

tests: expired OAuth state fails closed on the database clock
rule 1: a cookie is minted only in a file the ledger names
a green old SHA, truncated checks, or a skipped-only CI can never report Ready
signed-out and nonstaff requests never reach GitHub, including detail URLs
execution joins the exact check id, run attempt and head SHA, with current runner availability
waiting-to-run filter follows CI jobs independently of merge queue
lifecycle filters include active jobs and keep merged PRs outside running stages
agent handoff includes verified PR context and separates merged failures from pending actions
live PR observations mark only newly added rows, not initial rows, updates or reappearing rows
the limit for the whole run stops it between steps
bulk agent handoff groups visible issues by author and excludes healthy PRs
post-merge stages follow exact merge checks and never infer Live from merge or partial results
post-merge filters require observed deployment stage and keep open PRs out
release clocks use stage job timestamps, ignore queued jobs and stop at completion
table duration and sorting follow deployment stage instead of historical PR checks
filter timestamps reflect stage events and Live sorting uses the last target deployment completion
Ready follows Draft before recorded CI and includes the combined image stage
Step column follows grouped release phases, prioritizes running jobs and sorts unknown stages last
combined merged/image stage excludes later phases and uses each row actual stage timestamp
automatic merge is restricted to ready same-repository develop PRs with known clean mergeability
FAIL and UNKNOWN guards never invoke expected-head validation or merge
draft, review, branch and head changes after the gate prevent merge
a verdict expiring during the last review reads never reaches merge
scoped history reads paginate beyond 30 merged PRs before branch/date filtering
date scopes use the selected PR event, exclusive upper bound and isolated stale caches
invalid filter syntax cannot reach GitHub and wide reads are explicitly truncated
custom date filters send inclusive local days as exclusive UTC bounds
CI read records belong to each Tracy account and survive head/status changes and route recreation
CI mark all persists beyond a 50-row page and keeps newly discovered PRs unread
CI read writes reject invalid input and cross-origin requests without changing records
CI read writes require an accepted staff seat
CI read write works through the full app and its shared CSRF guard
